authorization: EXAMPLE ONLY: configure endpoints and obtain consent before any API requests.
base_protocol_status: Immutable server-pair protocol; this extension does not edit its requests, manifests, source files, identities or checkpoints.
addition_timing: Added at user request while Qwen and DeepSeek were running. Progress inspected before the addition was Qwen 8/260 and DeepSeek 6/260, with request statuses and reasoning telemetry but no formal-label aggregate used to select a model or change the rubric.
sampling_note: No temperature is sent to the Responses reasoning endpoint. Qwen and DeepSeek retain their existing temperature=0 settings. Equal requested mid-tier effort is not equal verified internal compute or identical decoding across vendors.
scheduling_authorization: EXAMPLE ONLY: configure endpoints and obtain consent before any API requests.
synthetic_preflight: Use the same four synthetic cases and unchanged rubric. All four must return valid schemas, requested-model identity, verbatim-quote gate and echoed reasoning.effort=medium. Positive thinking-token metadata is required in the separate preflight capability check and recorded per item; do not require every trivial case to consume positive reasoning tokens and do not retry a schema-valid answer to increase thinking. Semantic matches are diagnostic and not a selection gate, consistent with the revised server-pair policy. Preserve failures and disagreements.
formal_policy: Run all 260 items with a fresh context per request; do not reuse earlier Terra attempts from the discarded three-model plans. Retain the first schema-valid answer and preserve quote flags without semantic retries. Inherit the fixed retry/timeouts and evidence rubric from protocol.json. Require returned model and medium effort on every successful response; no automatic model or non-thinking fallback.

panel.preserve_original_pair: Retain the previously specified Qwen/DeepSeek agreement and disagreement analyses unchanged. Terra is an additional independent-context judge, not a replacement or adjudicator.
panel.secondary_majority: Descriptive only, conditional on all three schema-valid responses. Two matching labels define a majority; three different labels remain no_consensus. Missing outputs remain missing. Preserve all individual verdicts and also report quote-valid subsets. No majority label is factual ground truth or human validation.
panel.bootstrap_unit: document, preserving matched conditions and same-document repeated items; never pool the two audit strata
panel.multiplicity: Descriptive/exploratory only; no new confirmatory significance claim
panel.private_join: Join the private sampling key only after final outputs are frozen; never send it to any judge.

limits: AI assessments are additional automated evidence, not human verification.
Separate requests do not establish independent model errors.
The proxy-reported model alias, effort and token counts do not independently verify underlying weights or unmodified routing.
Qwen requests medium; DeepSeek uses the accepted 1-100 midpoint 50; Terra requests medium through Responses. Actual compute is not matched.
The paired-cache audit covers 20 documents and seed42, not all test documents or supplemental conditions.
